verdict.rationale: Khoj can index 'as many repositories as you want' via GitHub integration and sync entire folders of files for contextual search/chat, which is the closest evidence to bulk operations over many items at once. However there's no evidence of true bulk actions (batch edit, batch delete, batch tagging, or multi-item processing commands) that an AI-native user would expect. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-action commands/API, evidence of processing many discrete items in a single operation beyond passive indexing, and any hands-on confirmation of this working at scale.
